name: How can I tell if I have a hidden water leak in my Avondale home?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if I have a hidden water leak in my Avondale home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs can indicate a hidden water leak. A sudden, unexplained increase in your water bill is a primary indicator. Other clues include persistent damp or discolored spots on walls, ceilings, or floors, a musty odor, or the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use. If your water meter continues to run even after you've turned off all water sources in your home, it's a strong sign of a leak. Addressing leaks promptly can prevent significant property damage and mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for unexplained high water bills, damp spots, musty smells, the sound of running water, or a constantly moving water meter when all water is off.
